why: the behavioural fs (design/w2b-node-fakes.md): each changed unit makes the same requests in the same order on both sides and differs only in what it does with the value fs answers. cachedCount reads back a JSON it wrote and takes another field; readOrEmpty tests the error code of a missing file against one fs never raises; savedName is the promise form of the round trip. Under the fake each is a WITNESS (the read returns what was written, a missing file is ENOENT); under the recording proxy alone (bRecord) the read answers a handle, JSON.parse of it fails alike on both sides and a drawn fault carries no code, so each is PASS-bounded: the gap the fake closes. lineCount is a refactor: PASS-bounded either way
